blurb: Empty Saddle Club is a member-owned equestrian club located on nearly 13 acres in Rolling Hills Estates near the Pacific Ocean. The club offers activities including team roping, cutting, ranch sorting, team penning, trail riding, and working cow horse. Facilities include three arenas, two hot walkers, and cattle for various events.
extraNote: Applicant fee is refundable · Membership requires 75% affirmative vote of Regular Members
